neighbours.label: the comma or full stop that closes a reported empirical finding, at the point where an interpretation ('indicating', 'suggesting', 'meaning') is about to follow
fire: Tumour size shrank by half in every treated rat, pointing to a strong effect of the compound.
The fossil layer contained no pollen at all, which implies the region was arid at the time.
Survey respondents rated the new policy far below the old one, a sign that support has collapsed.
Blood glucose stayed flat for six hours after the meal, so the drug clearly slows absorption.
The probe recorded a steady drop in magnetic field strength, consistent with a cooling core.
Enzyme activity doubled when zinc was added to the culture, implying zinc acts as a cofactor.
None of the vaccinated volunteers developed symptoms during the trial, meaning the protection held.
Seedlings grown under blue light were twice as tall as the controls, suggesting a light-driven growth signal.
quiet: Tumour samples were stored in a freezer and shipped to the lab on Monday afternoon.
The fossil layer was photographed, catalogued, wrapped in plaster and carried to the truck.
Survey respondents were mailed a paper form, a pen and a prepaid return envelope.
Blood was drawn at eight in the morning and again just before lunch on both days.
The probe was launched in March, crossed the asteroid belt and reached orbit in June.
Zinc, copper and iron were weighed out and added to the culture flasks one by one.
The vaccinated volunteers met in the clinic lobby, signed forms and waited for their names.
Seedlings were moved to the greenhouse, watered twice a week and labelled with tags.

notes: Card: top peaks are ',' '.' '?' right after a result statement; the + pole's logit effect suppresses 'meaning/indicates/suggests', so the - pole sets up an inference. Probe: 'after treatment,' 0.33 vs narrative commas ~0.01.
